= CLI abstractions/frameworks

Libraries for building command-line interfaces in Node.js, covering argument
parsing, interactive prompts, and terminal colour output.

* https://github.com/infinitered/gluegun[gluegun]

* https://github.com/npm/nopt[nopt]
* https://github.com/gkz/optionator[optionator]
* https://github.com/minimistjs/minimist[minimist]
* https://yargs.js.org/[yargs]
* https://github.com/medikoo/cli-color[cli-color]
